recognitionRules: Use dark teal headings on a pale, quiet ground.
Keep filters separate from result cards and show the result count.
Give time, title and venue a consistent order within each session.
Reserve rust for focused actions and retain a clear reset path.

writingLinks.name: Plain-language service
writingLinks.reason: Public task: help people find a suitable session and recover from empty results.

quote: Find a time that fits. Read the details before you go.
rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use THE PROGRAMME FINDER in Arial with two short aligned listing rules. No magnifying-glass logo; search is a function, not the whole identity.
invariants: Use dark teal headings on a pale, quiet ground.
Keep filters separate from result cards and show the result count.
Give time, title and venue a consistent order within each session.
adaptations: Mobile cards stack details without hiding access information.
Print output includes the full chosen programme and filter context.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
decisionStatus: Template-derived editorial identity for the requested library. Creative rules are proposed production directions; no real organization or official endorsement is asserted.
